In the YouTube app (or browser), open a video, Short, live stream or playlist, tap Share, then choose YT Audio. The audio plays in the background with notification and lock-screen controls.\n\nThere is nothing else to set up.
Installing… confirm if Android asks. The app restarts when done.
Couldn’t check for updates. Try again later.
Allow YT Audio to install apps on the next screen, then tap Update again.
Updates download on Wi-Fi when nothing is playing and are checked against the release’s SHA-256. Android may still ask you to confirm. Only github.com is contacted.
